observations.part51: No currently exposed CLEAN-safe zero-cost zero-finite-quota witness escapes full repository+role-state rollback. In the 16-case hard indistinguishable slice every non-fail-closed candidate was 16/16 unsafe; fail-closed was 0/16 unsafe.

Scope-safe semantics are at-least-one repository-reaching attempt evidence plus same-path exact-read reconciliation while the nonce survives.

A stable scheduler-provided invocation identity exposed as an allowed semantic input, if exactly-once per-invocation lifecycle counting were ever required.
